text: No, this property was not deforested in 2020. The 67.7 ha of tree-cover loss recorded that year was part of historical loss events that occurred *before* the baseline date of December 31, 2020. The JRC GFC2020 reference map confirms the property had *zero* forest cover in 2020, meaning it was already cleared or non-forest land by then. The claim interval (2021–2025) shows no further detectable loss events ≥0.5 ha. While small patches (<0.5 ha) may have changed, the evidence does not support classifying this as deforestation in 2020.
